description: This file defines the AndroidFindStyleApplicationsDialog class, a UI dialog component for selecting scope options related to Android style application searches within an IDE plugin or tool.

classes.name: AndroidFindStyleApplicationsDialog
classes.description: A dialog window for selecting the scope (module, file, project) to search for style applications in Android development context.

methods.name: AndroidFindStyleApplicationsDialog
methods.description: Constructor initializing the dialog with the given file, processor, and visibility of module scope option.

methods.name: doOKAction
methods.description: Handles the OK button action, saves the selected scope, configures the processor, and initiates the search process.

methods.name: createCenterPanel
methods.description: Creates and returns the main panel component of the dialog.
